author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: New numeric cassetteDaysLeft attribute: the cassette countdown in days, parsed from WaterGuru's countdown text ("4 days left" is 4, "1 week 3 days left" is 10). Due or past-due texts, and the "0 left" WaterGuru shows when a cassette runs out, are 0. It is published only when the text can be read: a bare number without a unit, or any other unrecognised text, publishes nothing rather than a guess. It is sent right after CassetteTimeLeft. Driver 2.2.1 declares the attribute. No existing attribute changes.
